translations.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
translations.bsb: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
translations.kjv: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
translations.asv: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
